versions.changelog:
Initial release of SharePlay Developer skill.

- Provides end-to-end guidance for implementing SharePlay and GroupActivities across Apple platforms, including visionOS support.
- Covers activity definition, session lifecycle, state synchronization (messenger and journal), and spatial coordination.
- Includes detailed quick start and visionOS launch-only workflows.
- Summarizes relevant APIs, best practices, UI surfaces, and key troubleshooting tips.
- Reference guides provided for group activities code samples, visionOS immersive space, and activation UI patterns.
